propositions: The S3 ticket-store backend documentation is missing from docs/config.md, docs/s3-backend.md, and the ADR index, leaving operators unable to discover the optional dependency and configure S3 without external guidance.

A new comprehensive operator guide docs/s3-backend.md must document installation, SSE-KMS bucket/IAM/CMK setup, git remote configuration, the AWS credentials/encryption trust boundary, and the auto-doctor 60-second stale-lock self-heal behavior.

A new ADR 0093 must record the decision to use git-remote-s3 (Apache-2.0) below the git layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, implement merge-based auto-doctor conflict resolution (vs upstream's interactive discard), and reject TTL lowering below 60s.

The ADR index artifacts (per-number marker docs/adr/.numbers/0093, regenerated docs/adr/README.md, and ADR bijection validation) must be generated via scripts/gen_adr_index.py and validated by scripts/check_adr_numbers.py to ensure consistency.
